title: Sex education
blurb: Biology, psychology, and culture — woven together. A language for boundaries, desires, and needs, without shame.
body: Biology, psychology, and culture belong together, and so does the teaching. We talk about arousal and consent, about touch, sex, and porn — and about everything else that's otherwise hard to put into words. It isn't about getting through a syllabus, but about finding a language for boundaries, desires, and needs, where no one has to perform being on top of it. The format adapts to the group and the setting.

testimonials.quote: [mock] My class asked more in that workshop than in a whole semester of biology.
[mock] The format wasn't awkward — students stayed with it the whole way. First time I've seen that.
[mock] After the workshop we had a new frame for talking about boundaries and consent. Signe gave us the language.
